messages:
maria-chen: quick question — we're bringing up the quantized reranker (int8) for the search pipeline. which relevance metric should we prioritize for the first pass: NDCG@10 or MRR@10? trying to balance business signal vs faster feedback.

samir: for ranking products I lean NDCG@10 (we care about top-k ordering). MRR favors exact top hit which can be noisy with diversified queries.

julia: agree on NDCG generally. also important: which dataset? MS MARCO is useful for comparability but our logs reflect real distribution (sessions, truncation). recommend dual eval (msmarco + sampled prod queries).

maria-chen: noted. prod sample size? and do we need to change query/doc formatting for the quantized model? saw score shifts on shorter queries before.

samir: sample ~10k queries stratified by intent (navigational, transactional, informational). for formatting: normalize unicode, lowercase, collapse whitespace, remove client-side tracking params from URLs. keep punctuation for code-like queries.

julia: also split long docs into passages with 150-token windows and 50-token overlap when we rerank. that reduced position bias in past runs.

patrick: infra note — if you want to run both metrics and both datasets in parallel, I can spin up an evaluation job pool. need config: batch_size, num_shards, and ground-truth qrels path. ping me with a config snippet. :thumbsup:

maria-chen: sample config I had in mind: 
```
metric: [ndcg@10, mrr@10]
datasets: [msmarco_passage_v1, prod_sample_2025-07]
query_preproc: [lowercase, strip_utm, normalize_unicode]
doc_split: {window:150, overlap:50}
model_variants: [fp16_baseline, int8_candidate]
```

samir: one more: ensure we evaluate calibrated scores — we saw quantized models compress margins. add an eval that checks score spread + rank stability (kendall-tau) between fp16 and int8.

julia: add a simple human review bucket for queries where NDCG delta > 0.05 and MRR drops > 0.02. we should spot regressions not captured by aggregate metrics.

eval-bot: quick stats from last run on a small pilot (2k queries): fp16 NDCG@10=0.412, int8 NDCG@10=0.401, delta=-0.011; fp16 MRR@10=0.278, int8 MRR@10=0.260, delta=-0.018. flagged 132 queries for manual review.

maria-chen: thanks — that delta is close to our threshold for rollback. let's run full 10k stratified test. @patrick can you queue it with samir's and julia's config?

patrick: queued — job id eval-20250715-9. ETA ~45m for 10k with 8 shards. I'll post results in this thread when done. :eyes:

samir: when results come back, can we also compute per-intent NDCG and per-length buckets? I want to see if short nav queries are driving the MRR drop.

julia: agreed. and include top-10 example diffs (old vs new ranking) with doc snippets and tokenized lengths. keeps human review fast.

maria-chen: perfect. will follow up after job completes. thanks all.
